dedupe_keys.name: density rasters of critical assets in argentina bolivia chile and peru volcanic exposure

description: This dataset gives 11 density rasters of critical assets for Argentina, Bolivia, Chile and Peru at 1 km resolution, prepared to assess the exposure of infrastructure to volcanic hazards in the central Andes. The layers cover power, water, telecommunication, transport and emergency facilities, each expressed as the density of assets per grid cell, in the UTM zone 19 south projection. Version 1.0 was published on 9 December 2025 by L. S. Di Maio at the University of Geneva. The rasters are available free on Zenodo under the CC BY 4.0 licence. Caveats: densities are derived from mapped asset locations, so gaps in the source mapping carry through, and a 1 km grid smooths the position of linear assets. It supports regional multi-sector exposure analysis for volcanic hazard footprints and could be combined with other hazards; a related record is the OCHA common operational datasets.
